verdicts.explanation: Section 3.4 lists the computed 300 K conductivities in the order 0%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% Cl@4c as 0.0, 4.2, 6.1, 5.5, 4.2, 0.4 mS/cm, so 6.1 mS/cm is the 25% value. The 0.281 eV activation energy is the low-temperature Ea for 25% Cl@4c, and the NNP-MD/Nernst-Einstein method and 300 K temperature are correct.

The paper gives 5.5 mS/cm as the 300 K computed conductivity for 50% Cl@4c, and the quoted 'actual value (5.5 mS/cm)' supports it. The 0.292 eV low-temperature activation energy for 50% Cl@4c is also stated in Section 3.4.
